title.zh: 依第 11 条发布的公告

text.en:
3rd. DECEMBER, 2002 No. S61

INTERNATIONAL INSURANCE AND TAKAFUL ORDER, 2002 (S 43/02) NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. day of July, 2002 as the date on which the International Insurance and Takaful Order, 2002, shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 21st. day of Ramadan, 1423 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of November, 2002.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI ABDUL RAHMAN B1N HAJI IBRAHIM Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
